thought.text: The sink's `sed` pipe likely block-buffers the logs. Let me restart the sink without the pipe and re-trigger the login.

action.command: docker rm -f smtp-sink; docker run -d --name smtp-sink --network workspace_default --network-alias mailcatcher python:3.11-slim python -m smtpd -n -c DebuggingServer 0.0.0.0:1025 && sleep 3 && docker exec workspace-postgres-1 psql -U daz -d daz -c "DELETE FROM email_otps;" && docker run --rm --network workspace_default curlimages/curl:latest -sS -X POST http://backend:4000/api/v1/auth/init-email-login -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"client":"dashboard","emailAddress":"admin@schule.de","schoolSlug":"eckener-schule"}' -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n"

tool_call.name: terminal
